name: nextduel
description: Dev scripts for the NextDuel monorepo (Go backend + React frontend).

scripts.build: npm --prefix nextduel-frontend run build && cd nextduel-svr && go build -o bin/ .
scripts.start: npm --prefix nextduel-frontend run build && cd nextduel-svr && go run .
scripts.test: cd nextduel-svr && go vet ./... && go test ./... && cd .. && npm --prefix nextduel-frontend run lint && npm --prefix nextduel-frontend run build
